description: This file implements a connection dialer with tracking capabilities for managing long-lived network connections, including connection creation, tracking, and bulk closing, primarily used for credential rotation in Kubernetes client-go.

classes.name: Dialer
classes.description: A connection dialer that tracks created connections for management and cleanup.

classes.name: ConnectionTracker
classes.description: Tracks active network connections and allows bulk closing.

classes.name: closableConn
classes.description: A wrapper around net.Conn that triggers a callback on close for tracking purposes.

methods.name: NewDialer
methods.description: Creates a new Dialer instance with default connection tracker.

methods.name: NewDialerWithTracker
methods.description: Creates a new Dialer with a specified connection tracker.

methods.name: NewConnectionTracker
methods.description: Creates a new connection tracker instance.

methods.name: Track
methods.description: Adds a connection to the tracker and returns a wrapped connection that stops tracking when closed.

methods.name: Dial
methods.description: Creates a new tracked connection using default context.

methods.name: DialContext
methods.description: Creates a new tracked connection with a specified context.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the connection and triggers the onClose callback.
